items.title: Call to Order
notes: Mayor Watters welcomed everyone and called the workshop to order.

items.title: Disclosure of Pecuniary Interest Under the Municipal Conflict of Interest
Introduction and Brief Overview (Presentation to be Added)
notes: Adam McNabb, Managing Director of Corporate Services & Treasurer introduced Paul Dray, Dray & Associates and outlined the agenda for the workshop. He outlined the journey taken to date regarding the development of a draft short term rental (STR) licensing by-law and the benefits of licensing these establishments.

Adam McNabb outlined the common components of a licensing by-law as well as other mechanisms used to regulate STRs. He indicated municipalities have a legal right to implement programs to regulate and license STR operations and outlined the limitations of licensing and land use tools also available.

Paul Dray, Dray & Associates outlined the various approaches other municipalities have taken regarding the regulation and licensing of short term rentals. He noted zoning provisions are used to provide definitions and to regulate land use and licensing is used to regulate the activities conducted on the land.

P. Dray explained the benefits of licensing and using an administrative monetary penalty system. He responded to questions regarding enforcement, parking restrictions and the penalties for not following the licensing rules.
